scope: Apple Silicon development build and integrated xtask package fixtures
assertions: Select the executables reported by Cargo and ignore stale default-target binaries.
Collect runtime library notice files with source attribution and per-file SHA-256 while excluding dev, build and proc-macro-only dependencies.
Carry the exact selected project, font and Cargo notice bytes in the standalone app's Resources.
Keep the prior output on invalid build output or missing declared notice. Recover an interrupted promotion and reject a concurrent packager.
open: Run the new packager with an actual release build and compare the resulting paths and executable hashes.
Resolve missing upstream notices for the actual emitted library set, audit OS runtime dependencies, and complete signed platform checks.
